title: Study on the Effect of Metformin on Inflammation and Biological Ageing in People with Prediabetes.
official: Phase IV Low Intervention Clinical Trial to Study Biomarkers of "inflammageing" and Senescence in Pre-diabetic Patients Treated with Metformin: A Study nested within the project “NLRP3 Inflammasome at the Crossroad of Vascular Inflammageing: A Novel Target for Senomorphic Drugs”.
summary: Main objective: To assess changes in biomarkers of NLRP3 inflammasome activation and resulting end-product in pre-diabetic patients treated with metformin compared to those not receiving treatment.

interventions.name: Dianben 850 mg comprimidos recubiertos con película

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Arms A & B: Prediabetic subjects	 -	Adults, male and female, aged 18-60 -	Must present at least one criteria of pre-diabetes: basal glycaemia of 110-125 mg/dL measured twice or 140-199 mg/dL after 2h of glucose tolerance test (75 g), or HbA1c between 5.7-6.4%. -	BMI between 18-35 kg/m2
2. Arm C: Healthy controls -	Adults, male and female, aged 18-60 -	BMI between 18-35 kg/m2  -	Basal glycaemia <110mg/dL and HbA1c <5.7% -	Absence of other CV risk factors at screening, defined as high blood pressure (BP ≥ 130/80 mmHg) and high blood cholesterol (total cholesterol ≥ 240 mg/dL or LDL-c ≥ 160).
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participants are not willing or able to comply with: all scheduled visits, treatment plan, laboratory tests, lifestyle considerations, or other study procedures.
2. Participants who are currently under medical follow-up for any medical condition (besides prediabetes for Arms A & B) or who are regularly taking medication for any condition, including any diabetic treatment.
3. Have a known history of drug substance abuse.
4. Active smokers or former smokers who quit less than 12 months prior to screening.
5. Any other condition that, in the opinion if the Investigator, may interfere with the outcome evaluation of the trial.
6. Any condition or situation precluding or interfering with the compliance with the protocol.
7. Women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) who plan to become pregnant during the 18-month study period.
8. Participant is currently enrolled or has enrolled in a clinical trial three months prior to inclusion in the current study.
